(3) The man returns to the center of the frame, holding the white drone box with both hands. He displays a surprised, wide-eyed expression with an open mouth as if reacting to the product. (4) The visual transitions to an aerial high-angle shot of a turquoise harbor filled with small white and blue fishing boats. The setting is a bright coastal area with clear water and concrete piers under natural daylight. The lighting is bright and sunny, highlighting the textures of the waves and terrain. (6) The camera pans over a lush green valley surrounded by high mountains. Small clusters of white buildings are scattered across the landscape under a clear blue sky. (8) A low-altitude tracking shot follows a lone person wearing a white shirt and black pants cycling along a narrow road that cuts through vibrant green fields under a heavy, overcast sky. (9) The shot switches to a high-altitude top-down perspective of a public park, revealing symmetrical walking paths, clusters of deciduous trees, and manicured green lawns in a geometric layout. (10) An aerial view focuses on an orchard with long, orderly rows of plants supported by wooden stakes, likely dragon fruit or similar tropical crops, set against a green grass floor. (11) A wide-angle panoramic aerial shot captures a vast mountain range overlooking a valley floor filled with irrigated agricultural plots. The sky is predominantly grey and cloudy, creating soft, diffused lighting across the entire landscape.
